note.zh: 选择用明火点燃样本后，本阶段要么突破（910，获得工程研究与 10 年“天顶燃料”），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败（915，科学家殒命，探索结束）。
note.en: After choosing the flame test the stage either breaks through (910: engineering research and 10 years of Vortex Fuel) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll (915: the scientist dies and the exploration ends).

note.zh: 失败分支：探球取回时只剩焦黑的遗骸，科学家死亡；获得奇异气体与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Failure branch: the recovered Sphere holds only charred remains and the scientist is killed; exotic gases and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 风暴中心的存在消失，留下的装置上取下一个永不停转的部件；探索结束，获得遗珍“永旋陀螺”。
note.en: The being at the storm's eye vanishes; a part taken from the device it left spins forever; the exploration ends with the relic Ever Spinning Top.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1。它可能奖励遗珍，因此任一帝国正在探索时其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0；探索者未得到遗珍时解除锁定。
notes.en: Draw weight 1. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it; the lock is lifted if the explorer did not obtain the relic.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 900–940 全部事件，补上 900.b 的失败分支 915（原为独立故事）。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 900–940; added the failure branch 915 of 900.b (formerly a separate story).

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的一个身体部位。
note.en: In the game, a body part of your species appears here.
